---
title: "About"
---

I'm a UC San Diego Business Psychology graduate focused on consumer insights and
market research. My work pairs behavioral frameworks and survey methodology with
applied analytics, turning what consumers say and do into a recommendation a
team can act on.

While earning my degree I was also the primary caregiver for my family, so
instead of internships I took freelance research and data work alongside a full
course load.

## Skills

- **Consumer research:** Survey design, customer segmentation, willingness-to-pay
  measurement, competitive benchmarking, positioning
- **Measurement:** A/B testing, difference-in-differences, regression
  discontinuity, synthetic control, bias auditing
- **Tools:** R (tidyverse, httr2), SQL, Qualtrics, Quarto, Git, Excel
- **AI:** LLM API integration, JSON-schema structured outputs, cost-optimized
  retry pipelines
- **Languages:** English, Spanish
